title: Fix quiz submission failure

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the 'failed to submit quiz' error in the quiz submission flow. Audit the submitQuizAnswers (or equivalent) mutation in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts and the corresponding backend handler in backend/main.mo. Ensure the data shape sent from QuizQuestionsPage.tsx matches the expected backend parameter types (e.g., sector, answers array, question IDs). Fix any type mismatches, missing fields, incorrect Candid encoding, or error-handling gaps. On successful fix, the quiz must submit without error and navigate the user to the Dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Completing the quiz and pressing submit no longer shows the 'failed to submit quiz' error message.
Quiz responses are successfully persisted to the backend after submission.
After successful submission, the user is navigated to the Dashboard page.
The backend correctly receives and stores the sector, question IDs, and selected answers.
Any prior quiz submission data for the same user is handled gracefully (overwrite or append as appropriate).
If submission fails for a legitimate reason (e.g., unauthenticated), a meaningful error message is shown rather than a generic failure.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not change the quiz question content or sector selection UI beyond what is needed to fix the submission bug.
nonGoals: Adding new quiz questions or sectors.
Changing the visual design of the quiz pages.
Implementing new recommendation logic beyond fixing the submission.
